description: We have an election coming up, and the citizens of District 8 must choose their next congressional representative. Two women each hope to be elected: Laura Jones and Jessica Steinmann. They are both industrious people, and both have the mental skills to carry out the duties of that office. One, however, has a value system that I like, and the other has values that do not work in our modern world.As you may know, Steinmann is the Executive General Counsel for the America First Policy Institute.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Laura Jones for Congress P
title: Community First
